title: Your Chrome

control.title: Allow Her to Control Browsers
control.desc: Her opens web pages and acts in them. Which sites she may use without asking is below.
control.defaultDesc: When the agent doesn't name a browser, new pages open here.
control.defaultLocked: Connect your Chrome to choose it. Until then, new pages open in the built-in browser.

off: Let Her open sites that need your sign-ins in your own Chrome, on the {{computer}} Her runs on.
on: Her's tabs go in a “Hermesh” tab group and work in the background. Closing the “debugging” bar at the top of Chrome takes a tab back.
ready: The extension is connected, but Her doesn't use it yet.
lost: The extension is not connected. Check that Chrome is open on the {{computer}} Her runs on, and that Hermesh is on in its extensions page.
noChrome: There is no Chrome on the {{computer}} Her runs on, so yours can't connect from there.
refused: Hermesh was just updated; the extension is moving to the new version and will connect in a few seconds.
refusedStuck: The extension is still running the old program. Click its reload button on Chrome's extensions page.

outdated.extension: The extension in {{name}} is too old. It updates by itself; to update it now, choose “Update extension” in its menu.
outdated.her: The extension is newer than this Hermesh; update Hermesh on the {{computer}} Her runs on.

guide.title: Connect Your Chrome
guide.store: Add the Hermesh extension to Chrome on the {{computer}} Her runs on. You only do this once.
guide.install: Add the Hermesh extension to Chrome on the {{computer}} Her runs on. You only do this once:

howto.developer: Turn on “Developer mode” at the top right of the page, and leave it on: Chrome may turn the extension off without it.
howto.drag: Drag the folder Hermesh keeps the extension in onto the extensions page:

load.macos: Or click “Load unpacked”, press ⇧⌘G in the window that opens, and paste this folder:
load.linux: Or click “Load unpacked”, press Ctrl+L in the window that opens, and paste this folder:

guide.already: Added it before? Find Hermesh on the extensions page and click its reload button.
guide.waiting: Waiting for the extension in Chrome to connect…
guide.waitHint: Still not connected? Check that Chrome is open, then on its extensions page find Hermesh, make sure its switch is on, and click its reload button.
guide.doneHint: Sites open here in every conversation from its next step. Disconnect it on this page at any time; closing the “debugging” bar at the top of Chrome also takes a tab back.

builtin.title: Built-in Browser
